kodaAi.title: Koda AI
kodaAi.role: Full-stack development of a corporate AI platform
kodaAi.description: An artificial intelligence chat platform built for corporate use, integrating with the Gemini API, Auth0 authentication, MySQL, and features for text generation, image generation, and internal automation. The platform also includes specialized scripts for different team demands and administrative dashboards to monitor adoption.
highlights: Integration with generative AI models and image generation through API.
User management and centralized authentication with Auth0.
Internal scripts created for specific needs across different teams.
Administrative dashboards for usage analysis and platform monitoring.

clientPortal.title: Client Portal
clientPortal.role: Full-stack development and architecture of a corporate client platform
clientPortal.description: A corporate portal created to centralize the relationship between company and clients, bringing together projects, products, attachments, responsible users, permissions, dashboards, and ERP integrations in one platform. The application uses React, FastAPI, MySQL, Auth0, and a Docker-based architecture hosted on DigitalOcean.
highlights: A complete hub to centralize projects, products, and strategic client information.
ERP integration and project organization by client, team, and category.
Access control with multiple roles such as administrator, manager, leader, editor, and client.
Architecture separated into containers for front-end, back-end, database, and microservices.

vilmora.title: Vilmora
vilmora.role: Full-stack development of an authorial calendar integration product
vilmora.description: A web platform in development to centralize and synchronize calendars from different accounts and digital platforms. The goal is to reduce scheduling conflicts, rework, and manual checks through a unified view of appointments and automatic blocking across connected accounts.
highlights: Calendar centralization from different accounts in a single experience.
Synchronization and automatic blocking to reduce scheduling conflicts.
Architecture planned for integration with Google and Microsoft ecosystems.
An application designed for productivity, routine organization, and availability management.

pdfExtractor.title: PDF Extractor
pdfExtractor.role: Technical evolution and functional expansion of an existing tool
pdfExtractor.description: A corporate tool for extracting and processing information from PDFs, initially created with basic features and later evolved into a more complete solution. The project was built with React TSX on the front-end and C# on the back-end, using local cache and integration with an established online catalog system.
highlights: Evolution from a simple first version into a more complete tool aligned with real team usage.
PDF processing without a database by using local cache.
Integration with an external online catalog system.
Structure prepared for future hosting on Azure.
